en.text: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.

zhSimplified.text: 泰尔王希兰，平素爱大卫；他听见以色列人膏所罗门，接续他父亲作王，就差遣臣仆来见他。

zhTraditional.text: 泰爾王希蘭，平素愛大衛；他聽見以色列人膏所羅門，接續他父親作王，就差遣臣僕來見他。

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门也差遣人去见希兰，说：

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門也差遣人去見希蘭，說：

en.text: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until the LORD put his enemies under the soles of his feet.

zhSimplified.text: 「你知道我父亲大卫因四围的争战，不能为耶和华—他 神的名建殿，直等到耶和华使仇敌都服在他脚下。

zhTraditional.text: 「你知道我父親大衛因四圍的爭戰，不能為耶和華－他上帝的名建殿，直等到耶和華使仇敵都服在他腳下。

en.text: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

zhSimplified.text: 现在耶和华—我的 神使我四围平安，没有仇敌，没有灾祸。

zhTraditional.text: 現在耶和華－我的上帝使我四圍平安，沒有仇敵，沒有災禍。

en.text: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’

zhSimplified.text: 我定意要为耶和华—我 神的名建殿，是照耶和华应许我父亲大卫的话说：『我必使你儿子接续你坐你的位，他必为我的名建殿。』

zhTraditional.text: 我定意要為耶和華－我上帝的名建殿，是照耶和華應許我父親大衛的話說：『我必使你兒子接續你坐你的位，他必為我的名建殿。』

en.text: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以求你吩咐你的仆人在黎巴嫩为我砍伐香柏木，我的仆人也必帮助他们，我必照你所定的，给你仆人的工价；因为你知道，在我们中间没有人像西顿人善于砍伐树木。」

zhTraditional.text: 所以求你吩咐你的僕人在黎巴嫩為我砍伐香柏木，我的僕人也必幫助他們，我必照你所定的，給你僕人的工價；因為你知道，在我們中間沒有人像西頓人善於砍伐樹木。」

en.text: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is the LORD today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”

zhSimplified.text: 希兰听见所罗门的话，就甚喜悦，说：「今日应当称颂耶和华；因他赐给大卫一个有智慧的儿子，治理这众多的民。」

zhTraditional.text: 希蘭聽見所羅門的話，就甚喜悅，說：「今日應當稱頌耶和華；因他賜給大衛一個有智慧的兒子，治理這眾多的民。」

en.text: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

zhSimplified.text: 希兰打发人去见所罗门，说：「你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都听见了；论到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心愿而行。

zhTraditional.text: 希蘭打發人去見所羅門，說：「你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都聽見了；論到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心願而行。

en.text: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”

zhSimplified.text: 我的仆人必将这木料从黎巴嫩运到海里，扎成筏子，浮海运到你所指定我的地方，在那里拆开，你就可以收取；你也要成全我的心愿，将食物给我的家。」

zhTraditional.text: 我的僕人必將這木料從黎巴嫩運到海裏，紮成筏子，浮海運到你所指定我的地方，在那裏拆開，你就可以收取；你也要成全我的心願，將食物給我的家。」

en.text: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

zhSimplified.text: 于是希兰照着所罗门所要的，给他香柏木和松木；

zhTraditional.text: 於是希蘭照着所羅門所要的，給他香柏木和松木；

en.text: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

footnotes.text: 5:11 20,000 cors would be about 120,000 bushels or about 4.2 megaliters of wheat, which would weigh about 3,270 metric tons.
5:11 20 cors is about 1,100 gallons or about 4220 liters.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门给希兰麦子二万歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所罗门每年都是这样给希兰。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門給希蘭麥子二萬歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所羅門每年都是這樣給希蘭。

en.text: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华照着所应许的赐智慧给所罗门。希兰与所罗门和好，彼此立约。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華照着所應許的賜智慧給所羅門。希蘭與所羅門和好，彼此立約。

en.text: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王从以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三万，

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王從以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三萬，

en.text: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

zhSimplified.text: 派他们轮流每月一万人上黎巴嫩去；一个月在黎巴嫩，两个月在家里。亚多尼兰掌管他们。

zhTraditional.text: 派他們輪流每月一萬人上黎巴嫩去；一個月在黎巴嫩，兩個月在家裏。亞多尼蘭掌管他們。

en.text: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门用七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門用七萬扛抬的，八萬在山上鑿石頭的。

en.text: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

zhSimplified.text: 此外，所罗门用三千三百督工的，监管工人。

zhTraditional.text: 此外，所羅門用三千三百督工的，監管工人。

en.text: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.

zhSimplified.text: 王下令，人就凿出又大又宝贵的石头来，用以立殿的根基。

zhTraditional.text: 王下令，人就鑿出又大又寶貴的石頭來，用以立殿的根基。

en.text: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门的匠人和希兰的匠人，并迦巴勒人，都将石头凿好，预备木料和石头建殿。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門的匠人和希蘭的匠人，並迦巴勒人，都將石頭鑿好，預備木料和石頭建殿。
